title: SSC MTS & Havaldar Recruitment 2024 (Multi-Tasking Staff) (Copy)
description:
<h2>Important Dates</h2>

<ul>

 <li><strong>Application Start Date:</strong> 10-05-2024</li>

 <li><strong>Last Date to Apply:</strong> May 15, 2024 (11:00 PM)</li>

 <li><strong>Last Date for Fee Payment:</strong> 2024-05-17</li>

 <li><strong>Exam Date (Tier 1):</strong> Expected in August 2024</li>

</ul>


<h2>Application Fee</h2>

<p>Candidates must pay the required application fee to complete the registration process. The fee details are as follows:</p>

<ul>

 <li><strong>General / OBC:</strong> Rs. 100/-</li>

 <li><strong>SC / ST / PwD / Ex-Servicemen:</strong> No Fee (Exempted)</li>

</ul>

<p>Fee can be paid online through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or by using Visa, Mastercard, or RuPay credit/debit cards.</p>


<h2>Vacancy Details (Category-wise Breakdown)</h2>

<p>A total of <strong>1085 vacancies</strong> have been announced for Multi-Tasking Staff and Havaldar posts. The category-wise distribution is given below:</p>

<table>

 <thead>

  <tr>

   <th>Category</th>

   <th>MTS Posts</th>

   <th>Total</th>

  </tr>

 </thead>

<h3>Age Limit (as on 01-01-2024)</h3>

<ul>

 <li><strong>MTS:</strong> 18 to 25 years</li>

 <li><strong>Havaldar:</strong> 18 to 27 years</li>

</ul>

<p><em>Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules for reserved categories.</em></p>


<h3>Educational Qualification</h3>

<p>Candidates must have passed the <strong>Matriculation (10th Standard)</strong> examination or its equivalent from a recognized Board or University as of the cut-off date.</p>


<h2>Selection Process</h2>

<p>The selection of candidates will be based on two tiers:</p>

<ol>

 <li><strong>Tier 1 (Computer Based Exam):</strong> Objective type questions covering General Intelligence, English, Numerical Aptitude, and General Awareness.</li>

 <li><strong>Tier 2 (Computer Based Exam):</strong> Objective type questions plus a Skill Test (Typing/PESS) for specific posts.</li>

</ol>


<h2>How to Apply Online</h2>

<p>Interested and eligible candidates can apply for the SSC MTS 2024 Recruitment by following these steps:</p>

<ol>

 <li>Visit the official SSC website: <a href="https://ssc.nic.in" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">ssc.nic.in</a></li>

 <li>Click on the "Apply" link and select "MTS & Havaldar".</li>

 <li>Complete the One-Time Registration (OTR) if you are a new user.</li>

 <li>Fill in the application form with accurate details.</li>

 <li>Upload scanned copies of your photograph and signature.</li>

 <li>Pay the application fee online and submit the form.</li>

 <li>Take a printout of the final submitted application form for future reference.</li>

</ol>


<p><strong>Official Notification Link:</strong> <a href="https://ssc.nic.in/Downloads" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Download Detailed PDF Here</a></p>
